title: Rubric: Precision Optical Dial Micrometer Zeroing

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Step 1: Wipe measuring faces with optical lint-free paper using a single continuous drag motion. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: Wipe measuring faces with optical lint-free paper using a single continuous drag motion.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Audible ratchet thimble must click exactly 3 times at uniform 0.5s cadence to apply standard 5N contact pressure. (Observable: Three distinct uniform ratchet clicks audible at 19.1s, 19.6s, 20.1s.) [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: Three distinct uniform ratchet clicks audible at 19.1s, 19.6s, 20.1s.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-03
criteria.description: Lock barrel screw must only be engaged after needle settles completely within +/- 0.5 division indicator. [source_claim_id: CLM-03]
criteria.observable_indicator: Required tools/materials: Indicator needle stabilizes at zero index line before thumb engages lock ring.
